blocks.text: As the holiday season draws near, Christmas tree lighting ceremonies have become cherished traditions for many Cebu establishments. BE Resort Mactan is no exception. However, this year, BE Resort Mactan chose a unique take of the traditional Christmas Tree– one that showcases the group’s heart and advocacy. BE the light On November 20, 2026, BE Resort Mactan officially embarked the holiday season with a ceremonial tree lighting ceremony at BE Resort Mactan’s lobby. This year, the celebration became even more memorable and purposeful as the resort introduced its unique take on Christmas Trees.
